newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP reasonably priced - fund manager.
newsitem.headline: EDP reasonably priced - fund manager.

text.p: Shares in recently privatised utility EDP-Electricidade de Portugal are not expensive around 3,200 to 3,300 escudos, said Jose Carlos Maia, president of the Portuguese Association of Fund Managers.
"The present price of EDP seems to be a reasonable adjustment in fundamental terms," Maia, who is also executive director of fund manager Caixagest, told Reuters.
"Our valuations show that present prices are reasonable in fundamental terms. Levels around 3,200 to 3,300 escudos are reasonable for EDP. We do not consider such levels to be expensive," he added.
EDP shares traded at 3,280 escudos, down 21, in volume of 987,289 at 1031 GMT.
The government earned over $2 billion from a heavily oversubscribed privatisation of 30 percent of the capital of EDP last week. The privatisation price was 2,250 escudos per share.
